title: Golf Power and Mobility Training
desc: Golf fitness and sequencing, done in between traditional workouts for those looking for additional golf specific exercises without compromising time away from a more traditional lifting program. Can be run all in one day or in a separate power day and mobility day.

Controlled, rotate through hips · Reps progress: 10/side weeks 1-2, 8/side weeks 5-8, 6/side weeks 9-12; load increases week 5+
2 s hold at full extension · Reps: 10/side weeks 1-8, 8/side weeks 9-12
